paragraphs: Chapter 879
Episode 220. Tireless (1)
Preemptive strike.
Of course, anyone superhuman could conduct solo combat itself, but the alliance still did not know the exact combat power and special abilities of the demons in the Demon World.
Therefore, they needed a warrior of excellent caliber who could escape from any 'sudden situation' in enemy territory. Unless Zito himself descended.
Jin, Murakan, Balas, Alpen, Tasha, Luna, Runtia, Tuven, Heijin, Vanessa, Zed, Veil, Hedo, Dante, Owl, Yona, Talaris.
They were superhumans who met the conditions of the mission.

Among them, Jin and Murakan, as the supreme commanders and the final card, it is right not to leave the command post as much as possible, and the leaders of the previous generations and the Black Knights, and Zed have to protect Hupester.

Veil is at the center of the barrier along with the Golden Army, and Dante, of course, cannot leave the empire. Owl and Yona are always on reconnaissance missions, and Talaris is still watching Zito's eyes.

Therefore, the ones who can move the most flexibly are Luna, Runtia, and Hedo. Even then, the constant mission of 'rift management' is common to all superhumans, so they can never be said to be leisurely.

"Rifts are continuously being created throughout the Alliance, and in response, our forces and superhumans are constantly going to the battlefield. The world is dizzy, so we cannot rule out the case where the demon tribes suddenly break the declaration one day and attack us."

"Yes, there is no guarantee that they will only attack Rute forever. Moreover, Ayulra said that Luke, the former deity of the Demon King tribe of the Church of the Sun God, will start activities in the Human World soon."

"Luke, it is also crucial what choice the Church of the Sun God makes when he comes to the Human World. Whether they will stick closer to Zifl, or break up... either way, they are the enemies we have to defeat."
Jin and his colleagues exchanged opinions for a while and chose the protagonist of this counterattack against the Demon World.
"Luna would be good."
"Yes, it seems better to send the strongest person among the three anyway."
"Unanimous."
Widely recognized.

Luna was a character who had the possibility of 'being able to win' in any situation. Starting with Shiron, Keliac, Ron, Talaris, etc. Luna was the character that all the peaks of the previous generation evaluated so.

The mission assigned to Luna was annihilation and inducing the exhaustion of Zito's flesh. From Jin's personal experience, Luna was the only one who could handle Zito's flesh exhaustion on her own while taking the least damage.
The strategy of the counterattack was simple.
Luna would infiltrate enemy territory alone and fight, and if support was needed, other superhumans on standby would join.
Most of the time, Runtia and Hedo would provide support, but depending on the battlefield situation everywhere, all superhumans of the alliance including Jin could join.
Of course, the best case would be for Luna to resolve everything on her own without needing support. And Jin, he trusted Luna.
As soon as the decision was made, Jin immediately communicated to the Sword Garden and relayed the situation.
{Yes, Small Master. It's the butler. I understand, I will send out the first knight immediately. Shall I coordinate with the Little Master of Archery, or shall I send you the Red Owl?}
"It would be good to coordinate with the Little Master of Archery."

{Well... Ah, Small Master! Is it a solo mission? That's great. I just finished clearing the rift area that I was in charge of. Ah, butler. Can I just use informal speech? It's always uncomfortable. I feel like I have to be formal all the time because I'm worried about the butler's feelings.}

{A knight must obey the law to maintain the dignity of the family. Hmm, but what... If it's that uncomfortable for you. I'll let it pass when we're not in a formal setting. Of course, you need the Small Master's permission. You must strictly follow the protocol in places where many eyes are watching.}
{Oh, thank you! It seems that the butler isn't always so uptight. You'll let me, won't you, Small Master?}
"Of course, Butler. I'll be in touch again. Sister, please take care on your journey."
[Alright, don't worry. I'll go and wipe out Zito's flesh or whatever and come back. Prepare about a dozen bottles of good liquor for me.]
{No, Butler! You outright rejected when I asked the same thing!? Where are you going, Butler! Butler!}

{It seems the president of the Black Sword Society has time to play with me. I'm on my way to check the documents, would you like to come along? Or would you rather go to the rift area that just reported in?}

{Damn, I'll go to the rift area! Those Demon World bastards. They're not even cockroaches, but they keep popping up endlessly. Anyway, I can talk comfortably to the youngest if it's not a formal occasion, right? Ah, youngest. Did you know? This great-grandfather is winning the bet again on the progress of Alpen and the rift clearance. That man seems to want to win against me even once. Hahaha!}
Jin chuckled at the fuss coming through the communicator. The vibrant appearances of his family and comrades were always a great strength.
"Okay, let's get to work too. Zed, check the battle reports from all over and upload the sorted ones, and Quicantel and Enya, please start moving towards the barrier."
"Got it."
"Yes, Grandfather!"
Kwaoul and Valeria had requested Enya and Quicantel to join the mission of forming a barrier.
The barrier of flame and the power of time.
The judgment was that applying these two powers through Kwaoul's inventions and Valeria's knowledge would greatly assist the entire barrier.
While Zet was sorting out the reports, Jin briefly visited Murakan's room. Murakan was lying in bed with a dying face, resting his head on Gilli's lap.
"My lord, you're here? Ah, this is...don't misunderstand. Murakan suggested that he might recover faster this way."
"Hey, Murakan. You know how busy Gilli is."
"Be quiet, get out quickly, kiddo. You're disturbing my rest. Ugh, strawberry pie... I really had a hard time this time... Ugh, Murakan hurts, soothe me..."
"Ever since he returned from enemy territory, his half-face hasn't come back, it's really worrying... Apparently, there's also a slight problem with his tongue. What should I do...!"
Unable to watch any longer, Jin quietly closed the door. A moment later, a click was heard as the door locked, giving him goosebumps.
'Murakan is really sick, but not to that extent. Is he pretending to be sicker to get attention from Gilli? Does Gilli not know this? Or could she be indulging him knowing it? I don’t know...'
Jin returned to his office and alternated his gaze between the reports Zet had brought and the communication device.
Within 30 minutes at the earliest, or an hour at the latest, the first report on the operation was expected to arrive from Luna.

'I shouldn't worry too much about Luna, but I am a bit concerned about the number of times she uses her red energy. When dealing with demons, it's okay, but when dealing with a great rift or Zito's flesh, she'll have no choice but to use her red energy. It's a shame I can't tell how much she has left.'
What happens if she uses up all of her red sword energy?
He suddenly had such a question. But Jin concluded that there would likely not be a major problem.
'If that were to cause a serious problem, Father would have given a stronger warning. But when sending Luna to the Black Sea, Father only said to be as careful as possible, so it should be okay.'
At that moment, in a plain of the 'Kingdom of Kikaro', located at the southernmost part of Huphester, Mot's cries echoed.
[Booong!]
"Sogungju, thank you again this time."
"I never imagined the day would come when I, after becoming the Sogungju of the Bi-Gung, would deliver unmanned fighters to the battlefield this way."
Cyrus sighed as she spoke.

She was aware that she and Mot were playing the most critical role in the war. However, she felt a sense of self-reproach over the reality that, as a representative of Bi-Gung, she wasn't leading the battlefield but assisting with the transportation of unmanned fighters.

"Feelings of self-reproach can be a good stepping stone for growth. Right now, Sogungju may be a little less powerful than me, but in my view, Sogungju has a similar potential as me. Initially, Sogungju is a formidable force for her age."
A little? Similar potential? Cyrus was about to respond when she shrugged. Luna was indeed not lying.

"Also, the loss would be greater if Sogungju and Mot were missing from the battlefield than if I were absent, right? So don't feel too sorry and wait for Manbing more leisurely while improving. Soon, the day will come when all your past experience will explode at once."
"I will take it to heart. But here already... it's a mess. I've been to this plain a few times for training when I was younger, but now it looks like a completely demonic land."
Cyrus said, looking around.

Everywhere was crawling with demonic castles, buildings, and violet magical energy. The monstrous castle standing tall in the middle of the plain was showing off its enormous size, reminiscent of the old imperial palace.
Luna burst into laughter at the sight, lifting up the Krantel on her back.

"After the fight, those guys who are nothing special are living in luxury. This time, I have no one to protect, so I can smash it as much as I want. You're not weak enough for me to protect, right, Sogungju?"
"I'll wait nearby with Mot."
"If there are guys who could be excellent nutrients for Sogungju's growth, I'll pick them out one by one and send them. Is that okay?"
"Ah, that's good to hear. I'll look forward to it."

Soon Luna descended from Mot, focusing energy on Krantel. The demonic castle immediately detected her power and activated its defensive magic and equipment, Luna watched the onslaught of attack magic and artillery with an emotionless face.
"Let's start by destroying the castle."
Runecandel 1st decisive battle
Breaking Through - Luna Runecandel
As soon as Luna plunged Krantel into the ground, a fierce earthquake seemed to overturn the entire plain.
